title: Compulsion loop gamification
author: Outside_The_Playtrix
selftext:
Compulsion loops make people addicted to feeds, to games etc. 

Traditionally they were absent from gamification apps because they exploit the user whereas gamification is supposed to be about empowering the user.  

So gamification apps were not able to compete. 

But now we can each build our own compulsion loop based gamifications because we aren’t exploiting ourselves by doing so. We can share them with loved ones. 

I call this iCLoop - I’ve been doing it through component free gamification already, but now making digital games is so easy and accessible, this is a trick I think people are missing. 

Generally I think the direction is gradual gamification away from screens, back to component free modes, towards a solarpunk  ‘Fully Automated Luxury Communism’ type paradigm. 

Who is with me?
